description:
All 60 fixed monuments. Every fixed-location monument, alphabetical, in one response (no pagination - the set is 60 and static).
Each carries `slug`, `name`, `tier` (1-3, null for safe zones and minor monuments), `is_safezone`,
`has_radiation` and `radiation_level`, `recyclers` (count on site), `has_tunnel_entrance` (underground rail),
`has_chinook_drop_zone`, `allows_patrol_heli_crash`, `no_build_area_sqm` and `icon_url`. Moving monuments
(Cargo Ship) are not included. Cached for one hour.
name: list_monuments
title: All 60 fixed monuments
